title: Spatial Information Sharing on On-Demand Service Platforms
eligible_reason: Game-theoretic model tested in a laboratory experiment with three information-sharing treatments (surge, full, local) assigned by session. Regressions of observed minus equilibrium efficiency on treatment dummies x period (some with lagged outcomes). No staggered adoption or TWFE DiD.
design_notes: Paper Regression Models.R: lm((obseff - eqeff) ~ TRTS*per + TRTL*per [+ lagdiff]); Estimations_Table 6.R fits behavioral-equilibrium models.
data_files_note: Raw session data for the three treatments shipped.
software_notes: R plus Mathematica notebooks for theory predictions.
